en: Color postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a church that was formerly a mosque. The view is toward the altar with a white marble altarpiece, crucifix, and arched windows framed by alternating red‑and‑white voussoirs reminiscent of Islamic architecture. Large wall murals depict Christ and religious scenes with soldiers, clergy, and nuns. The back side has multilingual printed text identifying the place, address lines, and stamp boxes.
